scripts.dev: npm run admin:build && wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run admin:build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml
scripts.dry-run: npm run admin:build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.toml --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply serverless-agent --local --config wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply serverless-agent --remote --config wrangler.toml
